rationale: Biogen/Ionis 2024 release: ASO designed to reduce ataxin-2 expression; development discontinued after ALSpire.

target_relationship: direct: AAVrh10-delivered artificial miRNA targeting SOD1

target_relationship: direct: RNAi designed to reduce SOD1 expression
rationale: Arrowhead describes ARO-SOD1 as an RNAi-based investigational medicine designed to reduce SOD1 expression in the CNS. The v1 rules gave it Small molecule via registry-type fallback.

target_relationship: direct (protein-level): human antibody binding misfolded SOD1 protein; does not lower SOD1 expression

target_relationship: direct (protein-level): AAV-vectorised antibody against pathological TDP-43
rationale: VectorY describes VTx-002 as a vectorised antibody designed to target toxic species of TDP-43. Registry text alone says only 'gene therapy targeting a specific protein'.

target_relationship: downstream of TDP-43 loss of function: ASO restoring STMN2; NOT a direct TARDBP relationship
rationale: QurAlis: ASO designed to restore STMN2 expression; STMN2 mis-splicing follows loss of nuclear TDP-43. Bucket = TDP-43 biology (downstream); direct target = STMN2.

target_relationship: direct (registry-based): individualised ASOs for pathogenic TARDBP variants
rationale: Registry summaries: personalised ASO designed for participant(s) with ALS due to a pathogenic TARDBP variant. Each record may be an n-of-1 study; several records may share one sponsor platform.

target_relationship: direct (registry-based): individualised ASO for pathogenic CHCHD10 variant
rationale: Registry summary: personalised ASO for ALS due to a pathogenic CHCHD10 variant. CHCHD10 is not in the cached Open Targets top-30 list.

target_relationship: direct (registry-based): ASO reducing calpain-2 (CAPN2) mRNA; CAPN2 is not an ALS genetic-association target here
rationale: Registry intervention description: ASO targeting the mRNA for calpain-2 to reduce calpain-2 levels. Bucket 'Other neuroprotective' is provisional (axonal degeneration rationale). v1 mislabelled it Symptomatic because 'calpain' contains 'pain'.

target_relationship: expresses human NDNF (transgene product); no gene-silencing target
rationale: Registry intervention description: AAV-mediated gene therapy designed to express human neuron-derived neurotrophic factor (NDNF). Registry type is GENETIC.

target_relationship: expresses an IL-10 variant from plasmid DNA (transgene product)
rationale: Registry intervention description: plasmid DNA producing a variant of the anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10. Non-viral; therefore not AAV.

target_relationship: direct: PIKFYVE kinase inhibitor (PIKFYVE is not an ALS genetic-association target in this dataset)
rationale: Hung et al. Cell 2023: PIKFYVE inhibition clears aggregation-prone proteins via exocytosis in models of diverse ALS forms. v1 placed apilimod in TDP-43 biology; moved to Proteostasis because the mechanism is a general protein-clearance route and the trial enrolled C9orf72-ALS. Reviewer to confirm.

target_relationship: no single gene target: proposed catalytic NADH oxidation / bioenergetic mechanism (sponsor-proposed)
rationale: Registry: aqueous suspension of clean-surfaced faceted nanocrystals of elemental gold in buffered water. It is not a protein or other biologic. Sponsor-authored work proposes catalytic NADH oxidation (NAD+/NADH) as the mechanism; mechanism label reflects that proposal and is not independently established.

target_relationship: direct (sponsor-described): sigma-1 receptor agonist; dopamine D2/D3 binding also reported
rationale: Sponsor describes pridopidine as a selective sigma-1 receptor agonist. ALS/MND Alliance notes D2/D3 binding as well. Selectivity claim is the sponsor's.
